Error classes

Source: R/errors.R
jax_errors.Rd

Port of jax.errors. Every error raised by jaxR is an R condition of class jax_error; the more specific classes below correspond to the exception classes of JAX and can be used in tryCatch() handlers. The exported errors_* values are the class names as strings, so that inherits(e, errors_TracerBoolConversionError) reads like the Python isinstance test.

Usage

errors_JAXTypeError

errors_JAXIndexError

errors_ConcretizationTypeError

errors_NonConcreteBooleanIndexError

errors_TracerArrayConversionError

errors_TracerBoolConversionError

errors_TracerIntegerConversionError

errors_UnexpectedTracerError

errors_KeyReuseError

errors_JaxRuntimeError

Format

Character strings.

Details

JAX exceptionCondition classRaised when
JAXTypeErrorjax_type_erroran argument has the wrong type or dtype
JAXIndexErrorjax_index_erroran index is invalid
ConcretizationTypeErrorjax_concretization_errora traced value is used where a concrete value is needed
TracerArrayConversionErrorjax_tracer_array_conversion_erroras.array(), as.vector() or as.numeric() is called on a traced value
TracerBoolConversionErrorjax_tracer_bool_conversion_erroras.logical() is called on a traced value (for example in if)
TracerIntegerConversionErrorjax_tracer_integer_conversion_erroras.integer() is called on a traced value
NonConcreteBooleanIndexErrorjax_non_concrete_boolean_index_errora traced logical array is used as an index
UnexpectedTracerErrorjax_unexpected_tracer_errora traced value leaked out of its transformation
KeyReuseErrorjax_key_reuse_errora random key is used twice while key reuse checking is on
JaxRuntimeErrorjax_runtime_errorthe XLA runtime reports an error

The tracer conversion classes also inherit from jax_concretization_error, and all of the classes that derive from JAXTypeError in JAX inherit from jax_type_error. Other Python exception types map to jax_value_error (ValueError), jax_not_implemented_error (NotImplementedError), jax_key_error, jax_attribute_error, jax_assertion_error, jax_overflow_error and jax_floating_point_error.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
f <- jit(function(x) if (as.logical(x > 0)) x else -x)
tryCatch(f(1), jax_tracer_bool_conversion_error = function(e) "use lax_cond() instead")
} # }
